scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.eval: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m evals
scripts.gen:api:ci: cd backend && uv run python scripts/dump_openapi.py > /tmp/dreamwalker-openapi.json && cd ../web && bunx openapi-typescript /tmp/dreamwalker-openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts
